robot_description2: This guy oozes evil -- literally. During the initial invasion of the Stardroids, Mercury was right there at the forefront of the invasion. Similar to what Dr. Wily perfected with the Devil series, Mercury's liquid metal body is fully malleable and able to amorphously form; useful for dissolving to catch enemies off-guard. At that moment, he'll launch the Grab Buster technique. This attack fires a bright flash of light - a struck target may feel fine at first, before suddenly feeling their life drain away from them and collapsing to their knees! Furthermore, when Mercury's cornered, he's been known to drain the life energy of his allies... he's slimy, and a coward, willing to say anything and do anything when it comes to his survival. He's also greedy, and he'll do anything to gain some cash - even turn on his own brethren. Strangely, he's also a communist. As far as Stardroids go, he's among the worst of them - don't turn your back on him!
robot_quotes_start: I'll drain your energy dry! Everything belongs to me!
robot_quotes_taunt: I'm gettin' paid a lot of cash for you to die!
robot_quotes_victory: The means of production, resources, this whole rock-- I'll seize it all!
robot_quotes_defeat: You little slime-ball! You made me lose my reward!
